blocks.title: Car seats, done by the manual
body: Most detailers skip car seats or soak them. Soaking and harsh cleaners weaken harness straps, which is why every manufacturer says not to. Here's what I do instead.

blocks.title: Why a mom of three cleans minivans
body: I started doing this in 2019 after paying a car wash $200 to vacuum around my kids' car seats. They didn't take them out. Nobody takes them out.
So I do one car at a time, during school hours, in your driveway or wherever the car's parked. If you're at work, leave it unlocked and I'll text you photos when it's done.
Want a certified tech to double-check the car seat install? Cobb County runs free inspection stations, and I'm happy to tell you where.

guarantee.title: If the smell comes back, so do I.
guarantee.body: Odor or stain back within 14 days? Text me and I'll redo that spot free.

booking.headline: Get on the calendar

lead.question: Which reset?
lead.notesHint: Car, number of car seats, any spill I should bring extra stuff for

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: No. Leave the car unlocked or the key in the lockbox. I'll text photos when I'm done.
Fragrance-free, kid-safe cleaners and a hot water extractor. Nothing that leaves a perfume smell your kids will complain about.

faq.q: Can you get out a milk smell?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Milk has to be extracted from the foam under the fabric, not just the top. That's the Big Reset.

faq.q: How long do car seats take to dry?
faq.a: Covers go back on the same day in most weather. If one isn't dry, I'll leave it with you to finish overnight and tell you how to put it back.

faq.q: Do you do regular cars too?

final.headline: Give me one school day.
final.sub: You'll get the car back, the lost-and-found bag, and probably a library book.
